name: Neural connectivity
failures: Disconnection from stroke and trauma, synaptic loss in dementia, maladaptive rewiring in chronic pain.

see.note: Full connectomes exist only post-mortem. Living imaging is orders of magnitude too coarse.

model.note: The hardest cell on this grid: a healthy connectome is the person, so the target state is the identity.

reach.note: Deep brain stimulation modulates activity; it does not rewire.

edit.note: No human wiring has been deliberately restored. Rehabilitation exploits existing plasticity.

verify.note: Behaviour is the only readout, and it is confounded.

anchors: Deep brain stimulation modulates circuits without rewiring them
